description: This file defines the interface for a Dispatcher component within the WPEFramework plugin host namespace. It declares the IDispatcher interface with methods for validation, invocation, revocation, and local dispatching, as well as nested callback interface ICallback for event handling and messaging.

classes.name: WPEFramework::PluginHost::IDispatcher
classes.description: An interface for dispatching and handling remote procedure calls and events within the plugin host framework.

classes.name: WPEFramework::PluginHost::IDispatcher::ICallback
classes.description: A callback interface for receiving events, errors, and responses related to dispatch operations.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a given token, method, and parameters before execution.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method with specified parameters and callback, providing a response.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes or cancels a previously set callback.

methods.name: Local
methods.description: Provides access to a local dispatcher instance if available.
